The front displays several colorful, embroidered or printed patch-like designs resembling food items (a red hexagon, two red circles, and blue rectangles). The material appears to be terry cloth or a similar soft, absorbent fabric with a visible looped texture.

The connection point of the neck strap to the main body is slightly ambiguous. The strap seems to emerge from the back but the stitching or attachment point on the front/side is not clearly defined, looking slightly fused or poorly resolved.
